# infrawrench_role_default_dashboard (Resource)

The dashboard members holding a role land on when they open the app.

Precedence is a member's own "My default dashboard" first, then their role's default, then the organization default. This resource sets the middle layer; members keep the ability to choose their own.

Works for built-in roles (`system_role = "member"`) as well as custom ones (`role_id = infrawrench_role.x.id`), which is why it is a resource of its own rather than an attribute on `infrawrench_role`: that resource refuses built-in roles.

The server refuses a dashboard the role cannot open: the role needs `dashboards:read`, and the dashboard has to be shared with the role or with the whole organization (see `infrawrench_object_sharing`). If sharing is narrowed later, members skip the role default and land on the organization default instead of a dashboard they cannot see.

Needs `org:settings:write` to change and `team:read` to refresh. Unlike `infrawrench_role`, whose writes are closed to API keys, this resource is **open to API keys**: the route lives under `/dashboards`, not `/team`, and choosing a landing page manufactures no authority, since the dashboard must already be visible to the role. Destroying the resource clears the role's default; the role and the dashboard are untouched.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Finance lands on the spend overview; everyone holding the built-in Member
# role lands on the on-call board. Members can still pick their own default,
# which wins over both.
resource "infrawrench_role_default_dashboard" "finance" {
  role_id      = infrawrench_role.finance.id
  dashboard_id = "1a2b3c4d-5e6f-7a8b-9c0d-1e2f3a4b5c6d"
}

resource "infrawrench_role_default_dashboard" "members" {
  system_role  = "member"
  dashboard_id = "2b3c4d5e-6f7a-8b9c-0d1e-2f3a4b5c6d7e"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `dashboard_id` (String) The dashboard's id, as it appears in the dashboard's URL. It must be shared with the role.

### Optional

- `role_id` (String) A custom role, e.g. `infrawrench_role.finance.id`. Exactly one of `role_id` and `system_role`. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `system_role` (String) A built-in role: `owner`, `admin` or `member`. Exactly one of `role_id` and `system_role`. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The role id. Use it (or `owner`, `admin`, `member`) with `terraform import`.
- `role_name` (String) The role's display name, for reference.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# A custom role's default is addressed by the role id; a built-in role's by
# its key.
terraform import infrawrench_role_default_dashboard.finance 1a2b3c4d-5e6f-7a8b-9c0d-1e2f3a4b5c6d
terraform import infrawrench_role_default_dashboard.members member
```
